scenes.text: Most AI agent failures start before the model writes code. The goal is vague, context disappears, web research gets noisy, and the agent reviews its own work.
scenes.visual: Four failure labels enter one at a time around a simple agent workflow.

scenes.text: Instead of another giant platform, add one control where the workflow is already failing: ProductSpec for intent, ContextVC for memory, ax for smaller web inputs, or Cloudflare's audit skill for a structured second review.
scenes.visual: Map each repository to intent, context, input, or verification.

scenes.text: For a small POC, start with the document or review pattern before installing the entire tool. Keep the business owner responsible for scope, evidence, and approval.
scenes.visual: Show a lightweight POC path: document, agent work, human approval.

scenes.text: Three projects use MIT licenses. ContextVC uses Apache 2.0. Recheck the exact license and preserve required notices before distributing modified code. This is not legal advice.
scenes.visual: Show a compact license table with a recheck reminder.

scenes.text: The useful idea is not a four-tool stack. It is four visible controls: intent, context, input, and verification. Read the full source-backed field note on aryateja.com.
